title: Decoy Effect In Search Interaction: Understanding User Behavior and Measuring System Vulnerability

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing user interaction logs using regression analysis to measure the impact of inferior 'decoy' documents on click-through likelihood, browsing dwell time, and perceived usefulness. The paper also proposes a heuristic metric (DEJA-VU) to evaluate the vulnerability of information retrieval systems to returning decoy pairs.
